statement: A version-2 comparative-efficiency epic, graduated specification, shared scale-evidence prerequisite, and complete linked Quest ladder define an outcome-neutral program for analytical estimates, paired alternative benchmarks, whole-topology cost projection, and fail-closed evidence-qualified claims.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
This Quest authors planning contracts and draft successor Quests only; it must not claim that comparative performance, cost, or scale has been measured.
The comparative program must consume the scale-certification profile and report identity instead of inventing a parallel run-profile schema.
Quest completion must depend on valid preregistered evidence, never on Lagrange winning a comparison.
